quest.title: Food Delivery
quest.description: Good Hunter has a delivery service in order to fulfill customers' requests, but due to its popularity, the service is heavily understaffed. Sara is looking for someone to lend a hand.
quest.rewards_formatted: Delicious Crab, Ham & Veggie Bake x1, Recipe: Sticky Honey Roast x1

talks.objective: Talk to Sara at Good Hunter

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Order for delivery

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Hey, Traveler! What's happening—

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: ...Oh, you're just here to eat, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: I understand, really I do... But I promise you I will make you the best meal you ever tasted if you just lend me a hand first.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Ernest from the Dawn Winery often orders food from here to pair with his wine, and his orders always come with special requests.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: This time he wants <color=#00E1FFFF>Fried Radish Balls</color> but with egg added in. Unfortunately, I'm fresh out of eggs!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: So if you could just go ahead and grab me a couple of Bird Eggs, that would be great.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: There must be plenty of Bird Eggs around Windrise.

choices.text: I only came here to eat; I'm starving!

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: There must be plenty of Bird Eggs around Windrise.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Once you've done what I ask, I'll treat you to something from the Good Hunter special menu! Much obliged.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your meal, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: Aha! My <color=#00E1FFFF>Fried Radish Balls</color>... and prepared just as I requested!

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: Mmm... Yes, the addition of eggs does indeed do wonders for the texture and aroma.

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: Oh yeah! I know what I'm doing when it comes to food. *mwah!*

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: Oh, and this is for you. Many thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I come bearing ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That'll do it. One moment...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: It's ready! Now, get these <color=#00E1FFFF>Fried Radish Balls</color> to Ernest, pronto!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: ...Don't give me that look, I know you're famished.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: There'll be a special Good Hunter surprise waiting for you when you get back!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Deliver meal fee

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You're back! Did you make the delivery?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's the fee.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Let's see... Excellent! Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Here, this <color=#00E1FFFF>Crab, Ham & Veggie Bake</color> is for you. It's fresh out of the oven, eat it while it's hot.

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: Mmm... Yes, that rich eggy aroma just hits you straight away, but it's not overpowering thanks to the freshness of the carrot. I've missed my calling, should have been a chef!
